specs.description: `ImageLibrary.tsx` — Image library. This project's call graph records DIRECT calls only, so a function passed to a container, destructured into an exported binding, or reached through a dynamic lookup is not one it can see. Within that limit it records no call to this module. At least one of its operations is exported. `LibraryImage` carries `id`, `kind`, `topics`, `description`, `tone`, `orientation`, `width`, `height` and 2 more. No requirements recorded yet — 2 operations were examined and no obligation was decided about them.
